author: DreamPrince
raw:
As someone who managed place 12th in a tournament of 60 people, and managed to place over 2000 points on the cartridge ladder, I think Aegislash is a Pokemon that has gotten better with the introductions of terrains: Aegislash! Here is the set I have been using. 

Aegislash @ Life Orb  
Ability: Stance Change  
Level: 50  
EVs: 32 HP / 1 Def / 15 SpA / 7 SpD / 11 Spe  
Modest Nature  
- Shadow Ball  
- Flash Cannon  
- King's Shield  
- Wide Guard  

The SPs let you live a Modest LO Gholdengo Shadow Ball 100% of the time.  What makes Aegislash really valuable is how it completely shuts down Pokemon like Gardevoir + Indeedee + Sneasler and Rillaboom + Salamence + Sneasler. In fact, it competely walls Sneasler and Gardevoir under certain movesets. I think Aegislash needs the LO to pick up 2HKOEs, and I think what separates it from Gholdengo is Wide Guard, allowing the team to manage around Expanding Force, Blizzard, and Earthquake and the like.
